paper.title_en: Kerr metric perturbations for second-order self-force theory
paper.abstract_en: We present a calculation of the first-order metric perturbation arising from a point mass moving on a circular, equatorial orbit in Kerr spacetime. The metric perturbation is specifically aimed at meeting the requirements of second-order self-force theory: it is highly accurate; incorporates all contributions, including those associated with perturbations to the black hole's mass and angular momentum; is in Lorenz gauge near the worldline and in (near) Bondi--Sachs gauge at large radius; and can be efficiently evaluated across the entire exterior spacetime. The Lorenz gauge gives a well-understood singular structure at the particle, while the (near) Bondi--Sachs gauge ensures the asymptotic fall-off needed for an asymptotically flat second-order source. Our formalism reconstructs the metric from separable Teukolsky-type equations, decomposed into spin-weighted spheroidal harmonic modes and solved spectrally on hyperboloidal slices. The resulting $(\ell,m)$-mode sums converge rapidly across most of the domain, but slowly near the point mass; we overcome this with a novel use of a puncture to extract accurate $m$-mode data, yielding output accurate to $\sim 10^{-10}$ per $m$-mode and suitable for use at second order. Our metric-perturbation results cover a range of Kerr spins $-0.9 \le a/M \le 0.9$ and orbital radii out to $50M$. In addition to its immediate application in second-order self-force calculations, our results can also be used as input to other calculations involving Kerr metric perturbations, including studies of environmental effects and quasinormal modes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该工作给出了Kerr时空中点质量圆轨道的一阶度规扰动，专门面向二阶自力理论的需求，融合Lorenz规范与（近）Bondi–Sachs规范，采用Teukolsky型可分方程、超曲面切片谱方法与穿刺法处理慢收敛，覆盖自旋-0.9至0.9及轨道半径至50M，输出精度约10^{-10}每m模，技术深度高、方法严谨、对二阶自力及相关Kerr扰动研究有直接价值。
decision.title_zh: 面向二阶自力理论的Kerr度规扰动
decision.abstract_zh: 我们给出了一项计算，即Kerr时空中沿圆轨道、赤道面运动点质量所产生的一阶度规扰动。该度规扰动专门针对满足二阶自力理论的要求：它具有高精度；包含全部贡献，包括与黑洞质量和角动量扰动相关的贡献；在世界线附近处于Lorenz规范，在大半径处处于（近）Bondi–Sachs规范；并且可以在整个外部时空上高效求值。Lorenz规范使粒子处具有被充分理解的奇性结构，而（近）Bondi–Sachs规范则保证渐近平直二阶源所需的渐近衰减行为。我们的形式从可分离的Teukolsky型方程重构度规，将其分解为自旋加权球面调和模，并在超曲面切片上进行谱求解。所得的$(\ell,m)$模求和在大部分区域收敛很快，但在点质量附近收敛缓慢；我们通过新颖地使用穿刺（puncture）来提取精确的$m$模数据，从而克服这一问题，得到的输出在每个$m$模上精确到$\sim 10^{-10}$，适用于二阶使用。我们的度规扰动结果覆盖Kerr自旋范围$-0.9 \le a/M \le 0.9$以及直至$50M$的轨道半径。除直接应用于二阶自力计算外，我们的结果还可作为涉及Kerr度规扰动的其他计算的输入，包括环境效应和准正规模的研究。
